newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Email buys stake in U.K. meter firm.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Email buys stake in U.K. meter firm.

text.p: Appliance manufacturer Email Ltd said on Friday it had agreed to acquire a 20 percent stake in Ampy Automation Digilog Ltd, a U.K.-based manufacturer of electronic electricity meters and associated products.
Email said Ampy develops and makes low cost electronic electricity meters, including prepayment models, which offer new features to electricity utilities.
"In buying this stake, Email gains access to Ampy's excellent technology and extends distribution rights for its products to Asian markets," Email's managing director, John Hanna said in a statement.

Email said Ampy's products were complementary to its own and the company had had a relationship with Ampy for some years with Email's electricity meter division being Ampy's most successful export customer in 1995.
At 3.45 p.m. (0445 GMT), Email shares were six cents higher at A$3.53.
